correctness.rationale: Finite abelian character orthogonality yields the exact N-q times Hamming-distance Gram kernel. Exhaustive mutually orthogonal within-block contrasts (dimension d(q-2)), between-block contrasts (d-1), and a 2x2 radial block give all eigenvalues and multiplicities. The radial block has trace T and determinant q^2. Strict ordering follows from T>q^2+1, while a Fourier-support contradiction using two coordinates different from each varied coordinate proves lambda+<1. Top and second eigenspaces yield the equality profile and sharp stability. The original package checker passed 1875 counted units, with direct Fourier matrix reconstruction in cyclic and noncyclic cases; finite checks do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The smallest nontrivial matching spatial/frequency Hamming-ball restriction is natural for exact Fourier sampling and uncertainty, with complete all-group solution: four sharp eigenlevels, injectivity, rigidity and optimal distance-to-extremizers stability. The central point qualitatively removes the nullspace present for a single nonbinary shell; d=2 is a sharp localization threshold, and d>=3 never supports perfect concentration. The exact minimum singular value supplies a robust interpolation constant rather than a mere combinatorial restatement or arbitrary finite instance.
